summary: Added LLM metric emission for duration and failure counters with structured error-code tagging. Failures now increment per-code counts and emit `llm_failures_total` metric events; LLM durations emit `llm_duration_ms` events. OpenAI adapter now reports failure codes through telemetry. Added a note documenting the change.
